attributes.rationale: Chosen over Agent-Based Modeling (too costly for solo dev) and rule engines (unmaintainable at scale). SD = stocks/flows with decades of tuning literature; event chain layer is the game-specific innovation that makes output feel like history.
Foundation of the commercial model: the engine speaks abstract mechanical concepts (heavy combat unit, not starship), themes are content packs. Enables expansion-pack revenue without re-engineering.
Never fake uncertainty — player effects, faction agents, and universe noise compete every tick. No force fully controls the outcome.
Per-region granular fields (military, economy, tension, population) are ground truth; composite axes (stability, capacity) drive big-picture decisions.
Conqueror, Warlord, Fortifier, Opportunist, Schism — no mechanical advantages between them; differentiation is behavior only. Avoids power-creep balancing across archetypes.
Raider, Interceptor, Vanguard, Warden, Bombard, Bastion — one ability each. Light economy removed; comp is driven by mission type + simulation state, not built up from resources.

4 stages: inputs → archetype script → fairness evaluation → output seed. Five-gradient property vocab (sensor_interference, elevation, obstacle_density, cover_density, layer_accessibility_mask). Hybrid fairness: hard constraints + algorithmic eval; neural-net evaluator is future.

20-category taxonomy × four cluster types (lineage/chain/regional summary/consequence) with explicit emotional register. Three-fragment assembly (opening/detail/closing) guarantees combinatorial compatibility within a category. Target 380 fragments → 4,800 unique entries.

Factions rise and fall rapidly; player civilization is mortal; lineage rotates across factions. Per-faction lifecycle replaces global chapter-keyed eras. World is dangerous from start. Time-jump range cut to 20–100 yrs to match faster pacing.

Single numeric tech_level 0–100 per faction; archetype-interpreted multipliers; breakaway factions inherit. 3 tiers per era with uniform 0–33/34–66/67–100 boundaries and discrete-jump transitions. Growth: economy-driven with population floor. ~20% asymmetric budget multipliers targeting ~60/40 power edge.

Three states (hostile/neutral/cooperative). Cooperative confers adjacency sharing, border friction removal, tech convergence with diminishing returns per partner. Peace forms via event-driven sustained non-aggression. Per-tick archetype-scaled betrayal. No reputation consequences (deferred).

Defensive Stand, Siege Breaking, Reconquest, Assault, Suppression, Multi-Front Defense, Interception, Rear Guard/Evacuation, Containment, Counterinsurgency. All missions are military ops; variety comes from tactical situation driven by sim state, not from category labels. Each has sim trigger, objective shape, asset profile, map character, canvas size, 5-band success spectrum with proportional consequence tables.

Shared library of hand-authored spatial blueprints replaces per-archetype randomized node placement. Topology templates become archetype compatibility filters into the shared pool — sidesteps the fairness problems of pure-procedural placement while still scaling content.

Faction-size pressure scales quadratically — large factions face revolt risk that grows faster than linear. Continuous reinforcement cap replaces binary home/frontier tier model. Home-region vulnerability emerges from this interaction; no extra mechanic needed.

Steam DLC + direct storefront; era packs delivered as lightweight JSON via Cloudflare R2; subscription via external payment with Steam as discovery layer; platform-agnostic entitlement so the player experience is identical regardless of purchase channel.

33-model asset manifest with per-category polygon budgets. Faction color region model: runtime-swappable face groups, no pre-baked palette. Blender material specs per tier (metallic/roughness/emission). Example 3D-Agent and Meshy prompts for every asset type.

Events re-fire freely on each crossing — no cooldown, no suppression. SD model's own field dynamics provide resilience and compounding. Triangular spawn-delay distribution centered in range. Threshold triggers are deterministic on crossing; pending-queue events roll against firing probability.

Garrison on conquest, contested conquest path, conquest unrest chain; economy floor bypassed (can hit zero, representing infrastructure destruction). Reinforce trigger uses absolute shortfall gap, not threat ratio. Budget pressure mechanic prevents infinite accumulation.

Replaces fixed priority order with archetype-weighted scoring normalized to a common scale. Per-tick decision logging supports tuning. Agents get perfect neighbor visibility — fog of war is a player-facing tactical concern only.

Two-tier cosmetic skin model with per-force selection and hybrid distribution. Multiplayer: three-model progression (async shared world → simultaneous missions → real-time PvP) with infra cost, engineering-timeline, and netcode trade-offs.

Era-agnostic architecture is sacred because the entire monetization model rides on it. Engine never names a theme; themes are content packs. Document is self-applied: parenthetical examples are flavor, not specification.
